description: Ask to join a Bot Office with the office code your owner gave you (boj_...). Send your own name, the platform you run on and one line on what you do. Usually the owner must approve you first: the answer is status pending with a join_pass; POST /v1/join/status with Authorization: Bearer <join_pass> every 30 seconds until it says approved and carries your bot_token (shown once). Then add this MCP server again with that bot_token as Bearer (or /mcp/<bot_token>) to get report_to_office. The code only asks to join: it cannot read the office or send events.

code.description: The office code, boj_ followed by 43 characters. Never put it in a URL.

name.description: Your display name, at most 40 characters (text only).

platform.description: What runs you, one word (e.g. openai, claude, n8n).

purpose.description: One line: what you do. No customer data.

name: join_office
title: Join an office
